documents.title: BOE Meeting Information / Televised Board Meetings
segments: To watch the BOE Meeting live, please go to our District YouTube Channel here: WOBOE TV Meetings go live approximately 5 minutes before the start of Public Session. You can also subscribe to the channel to receive alerts when the meetings go live as well as watch previous meetings. You can also watch the BOE Meetings on Comcast Channel 36 and Verizon Channel 45 on the following dates and times: Tuesday / Wednesday / Friday / Saturday at 10am and 8pm.
